d.title: Overview of long-term stability & durability
d.body:
Stone — Palimanan. A natural, elegant look, improved thermal comfort, outdoor durability, ideal for façades, feature walls, terraces and pool areas.

Wood — Bengkirai. High strength, durability and natural resistance to weathering; warm golden-brown tones add a timeless aesthetic.

Rattan — Lampit. Warmth, texture and natural character for wall coverings, ceilings and decorative panels.

Tiles — Sukabumi. Natural, elegant appearance, excellent durability, cooling effect underfoot, natural anti-slip for pools and terraces.
